1.text: Mose n'abakuru b'Abisirayeli bategeka abantu bati “Muhore mwitondera amategeko yose mbategeka uyu munsi.

2.text: Kandi ubwo muzambuka Yorodani mukagera mu gihugu Uwiteka Imana yanyu ibaha, uzishingire ibibuye binini ubihome ingwa.

3.text: Uzandike kuri ibyo bibuye amagambo yose y'ayo mategeko, numara kwambutswa no kujya mu gihugu Uwiteka Imana yawe iguha, igihugu cy'amata n'ubuki, nk'uko Uwiteka Imana ya ba sekuruza banyu yagusezeranije.

4.text: Nuko nimumara kwambuka Yorodani muzashinge ibyo bibuye mbategetse uyu munsi ku musozi wa Ebali, ubihome ingwa.

5.text: Kandi uzubakireyo Uwiteka Imana yawe igicaniro cy'amabuye, ntuzayakozeho ikintu cy'icyuma.

6.text: Uzubakishe igicaniro cy'Uwiteka Imana yawe amabuye atabajwe, abe ari cyo utambiriraho Uwiteka Imana yawe ibitambo byoswa,

7.text: kandi utambireyo ibitambo by'uko muri amahoro ubirīreyo, wishimire imbere y'Uwiteka Imana yawe.

8.text: Uzandike kuri ibyo bibuye amagambo yose y'aya mategeko, wandikishije gukeba inyuguti zisomeka neza.”

9.text: Mose n'abatambyi b'Abalewi babwira Abisirayeli bose bati “Wa bwoko bw'Abisirayeli we, ceceka wumve: uyu munsi uhindutse ubwoko bw'Uwiteka Imana yawe.

10.text: Ni cyo gituma ukwiriye kumvira Uwiteka Imana yawe, ukitondera amategeko y'Uwiteka y'uburyo bwose, ngutegeka uyu munsi.”

11.text: Mose yihanangiriza abantu kuri uwo munsi ati

12.text: “Aba azabe ari bo bahagarikwa ku musozi wa Gerizimu no kwifuriza abantu umugisha, nimumara kwambuka Yorodani: ab'imiryango ya Simiyoni na Lewi na Yuda, na Isakari na Yosefu na Benyamini.

13.text: Kandi aba azabe ari bo bahagarikwa ku musozi wa Ebali no kuvuga umuvumo: ab'imiryango ya Rubeni na Gadi na Asheri, na Zebuluni na Dani na Nafutali.”

14.text: Abalewi babwize Abisirayeli bose ijwi rirenga bati

15.text: “Nihagira umuntu urema igishushanyo kibajwe cyangwa kiyagijwe, ikizira Uwiteka yanga urunuka, kiremwa n'umuhanga wabyo akagishinga rwihishwa, avumwe.”Abantu bose babasubize bati “Amen!”

16.text: Abalewi bati “Usuzugura se cyangwa nyina avumwe.”Abantu bose bavuge bati “Amen!”

17.text: Abalewi bati “Uhina imbago z'urubibi rwa mugenzi we avumwe.”Abantu bose bavuge bati “Amen!”

18.text: Abalewi bati “Uyobya impumyi inzira avumwe.”Abantu bose bavuge bati “Amen!”

19.text: Abalewi bati “Ugoreka urubanza rw'umusuhuke w'umunyamahanga, cyangwa rw'impfubyi cyangwa rw'umupfakazi, avumwe.”Abantu bose bavuge bati “Amen!”

20.text: Abalewi bati “Usambana na muka se avumwe, kuko aba yorosoye umwenda wa se akamwambika ubusa.”Abantu bose bavuge bati “Amen!”

21.text: Abalewi bati “Uryamana n'itungo ryose avumwe.”Abantu bose bavuge bati “Amen!”

22.text: Abalewi bati “Usambana na mushiki we basangiye se cyangwa nyina, avumwe.”Abantu bose bavuge bati “Amen!”

23.text: Abalewi bati “Usambana na nyirabukwe avumwe.”Abantu bose bavuge bati “Amen!”

24.text: Abalewi bati “Uwica mugenzi we rwihishwa avumwe.”Abantu bose bavuge bati “Amen!”

25.text: Abalewi bati “Uwenda ibiguzi byo kwicisha utacumuye avumwe.”Abantu bose bavuge bati “Amen!”

26.text: Abalewi bati “Udasohoza amagambo y'ayo mategeko ngo ayumvire, avumwe.”Abantu bose bavuge bati “Amen!”
